newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Dow Chemical, Previmil buy stake in Brazil's EDN.
newsitem.headline: Dow Chemical, Previmil buy stake in Brazil's EDN.

text.p: Dow Chemical Co's Dow Quimica unit and Previmil have acquired a 26.74 minority stake in Brazilian petrochemical firm Estireno do Nordeste (EDN) at a privatization auction on the Rio de Janeiro stock exchange, an exchange official said.
Dow Quimica acquired 4,283,000 shares for 36 reais per 1,000 shares and Previmil acquired 127,000 shares for 36.10 reais per 1,000 shares.
Bidding for the minority stake, which belonged to Petroquisa, a subsidiary of state oil firm Petrobras, started at 36 reais per 1,000 shares.
EDN is the last of 25 minority petrochemical holdings mostly belonging to Petroquisa which have been sold off by Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES).
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
